info.title: ioviewer
info.description: Command line tool for generating standalone interactive 3D WebGL/HTML BIM & CAD model viewers with no external dependencies that work offline.

options.name: --title
options.description: Page title shown in the browser tab.

options.name: --wireframe
options.description: Enable wireframe display mode by default.

options.name: --white-mode
options.description: Enable white/clay architectural rendering mode by default.

options.name: --no-properties
options.description: Exclude element properties to reduce the file size.

options.name: --json
options.description: Export structured model snapshot to JSON.

options.name: --serve
options.description: Start local HTTP preview server and open in default browser.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message and exit.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version information and exit.
Exit codes:
0  Success
1  Usage error (missing or invalid arguments)
2  File not found
3  Data format error or parsing failure

arguments.name: OUTPUT
arguments.description:
Destination path for exported file (.html or .json).
Default: <input-without-ext>.html.
